title: Why Your Subconscious Mind Controls Your Life (1981-06-29)
description:
Do you feel stuck in old patterns? Discover how your subconscious conditioning shapes your reality, the spiritual roots of illness, and how to finally break free.

This talk explores the Left Side (subconscious mind) and how unresolved past habits create conditioning. Shri Mataji explains the spiritual causes of psychosomatic diseases like cancer and the danger of modern 'emergencies.' Includes a candid Q&A on dealing with negative attacks and a guided self-realization experience.

Key Topics:
• 🌙 Understanding the subconscious (Left Side) - how past habits and conditioning trap our attention
• 🔬 The spiritual link between subconscious overload, insecurity, and diseases like cancer
• 💭 Why we project our own limited concepts onto God and how to move beyond mental ideas
• 💬 Q&A Wisdom: When to face negative energy and when to run away (The Krishna Strategy)
• ✨ Guided self-realization experience - clear your conditioning and feel the cool breeze of the Spirit

“Whatever you think is not God, because if you could think, then He is not God... You can only become one with It. It would be like a little bird trying to fathom the ocean.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Audience Questions:
• If we are attacked by negative energy, should we try to avoid it or accept it?
• What happens to the desires we lose in cleansing? Do people we are connected with bear that burden?

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How to clear past conditioning and subconscious patterns?
• What is the spiritual cause of cancer and diseases?
• How to balance tradition and modernity in spiritual life?

Have you noticed specific habits or 'emergencies' you create in daily life that drain your energy? Share your experience below.
